description.zh:
下一个查询开始Token，用来返回更多结果。
> 第一次查询不需要提供本参数，如果一次查询没有返回全部结果，则可在后续查询中传入前一次返回的**NextToken**值以继续查询。
description.en:
The token used to start the next query to retrieve more results.

> This parameter is not required in the first query. If not all results are returned in one query, you can specify the **NextToken** value returned for the query to perform the next query.
The region ID of the instance.

description.zh:
实例ID列表。

> * 本参数和**Tag**参数两者中必须传入一项。
description.en:
The IDs of the instances.

> *   You must specify this parameter or the **Tag** parameter.
The resource type. Set the value to **INSTANCE**.

description.zh: 实例的标签信息。本参数和**ResourceId**参数两者中必须传入一项。
description.en: The tags of the instance. You must specify this parameter or the **ResourceId** parameter.
The keys of the tags associated with the instances you want to query.
The values of the tags associated with the instances you want to query.

descriptions.zh: 该API对应的控制台操作请参见[根据标签筛选实例](~~119160~~)和[查看实例绑定的标签](~~134038~~)。
descriptions.en: You can also query the relationships between instances and tags in the Tair (Redis OSS-compatible) console. For more information, see [Filter Tair (Redis OSS-compatible) instances by tag](~~119160~~) and [View tags bound to an instance](~~134038~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun r-kvstore list-tag-resources --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-type INSTANCE --next-token 212db86sca4384811e0b5e8707ec20000 --resource-id r-bp1zxszhcgatnx0000 --tag Value=demovalue Key=demokey --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun r-kvstore ListTagResources --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceId.1 'r-bp1zxszhcgatnx0000' --Tag.1.Key demokey --NextToken 212db86sca4384811e0b5e8707ec20000 --Tag.1.Value demovalue --ResourceType INSTANCE --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
